setup: You want the [[which]] integer x with 1/(x − [[a]]) [[sign]] 0.

steps.say: The numerator 1 is positive and always will be, so the fraction takes the sign of its denominator. That also means x = [[a]] is excluded, where the fraction is undefined.
So x − [[a]] [[sign]] 0, which is x [[sign]] [[a]], and the [[which]] integer on that side of [[a]] is [[ans]].
